nodes.name: Parse Breadth Report
nodes.notes: Regex port of add_breadth_week.py's parser — tested standalone (node parse_breadth_report.js) against the Sep 11 and Sep 18 2026 reports before being pasted in here; implied per-category totals (count/pct) came out consistent across every metric, which is the check that columns lined up with the right category.

nodes.name: Insert into Supabase (platform_breadth)
nodes.notes: Plain insert, no upsert — the unique(week_of, section, category, metric) constraint makes a re-run of the same week fail loudly (shows red in the execution log) instead of silently duplicating or overwriting. If you genuinely need to re-import a week, delete its rows in Supabase first. Needs SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY set as environment variables on the n8n host.
